what: Explore an object you already read
title: GUI Components to Explore Stable Isotope Data Files
text: focused explorers take -memory ir_isofiles object show one measurement type time — file-selector sidebar left plot right: object may mixed-type (explorer filters type). default run detached: app launched separate R process (via callr, object handed temporary .rds) opened browser, R session stays free. Closing browser tab stops app process; process also killed R session exits, nothing left running. Pass detached = FALSE instead run app current session (blocking) shiny::runApp(); add launch = FALSE get [shiny::shinyApp()] object back unrun (deployment manual launching). Called document rendered (knitr / Quarto), don’t launch — print note run interactively. functions also accept: variable_name — name used object generated Show code output. defaults deparsed expression passed, my_iso |> ie_explore_scans() writes code starting my_iso; override ie_explore_scans(iso, variable_name = "special_name"). initial_selection — filter expression evaluated aggregated metadata: FALSE (default — nothing selected), TRUE (everything), [dplyr::filter()] condition ie_explore_continuous_flow(iso, initial_selection = grepl("std", file_name)). detached mode must self-contained (re-evaluated separate process).
code: library(isoexplorer)  iso <- isoreader2::ir_find_continuous_flow("path/to/files") |>   isoreader2::ir_read_isofiles()  ie_explore_continuous_flow(iso) ie_explore_dual_inlet(iso) ie_explore_scans(iso) ie_explore_metadata(iso)   # just the selector table

what: Start a server that loads data at runtime
title: GUI Components to Explore Stable Isotope Data Files
text: ie_create_isofiles_server() builds full multi-tab app (one tab per measurement type) isofiles argument, returns [shiny::shinyApp()] object run (shiny::runApp()) deploy. Data arrives runtime via: navbar Load examples button (default — copies isoreader2 bundled examples ir_copy_examples() reads ), navbar Upload button (upload_folder = "/dir"): files isoreader2 type, .json serializations, .zip archives stored, read, added automatically, watched folders (monitoring_folders = "/dir"): isofiles appearing picked automatically. newly seen files ever read, adding files cheap. “get started” prompt shown something loaded. Shiny caps uploads 5 MB per file default; since raw isofiles often larger, raise max_upload_size (MB): Behind reverse proxy (e.g. nginx front ShinyProxy) may also need raise proxy’s request-body limit (nginx: client_max_body_size).
code: ie_create_isofiles_server() |> shiny::runApp()                       # Load examples / upload ie_create_isofiles_server(upload_folder = "uploads", monitoring_folders = "incoming") |>   shiny::runApp() ie_create_isofiles_server(upload_folder = "uploads", max_upload_size = 200) |>   shiny::runApp()

title: GUI Components to Explore Stable Isotope Data Files
text: Every app Show code button (top-right navbar) assembles, modules currently view, isoreader2 code reproduces plot — read → aggregate → plot — opens read-editor. faithful current state: intensity units, selected files/analyses (ir_filter_metadata(...)), chosen species/masses/ratios, scan type, zoom window, every plot option reflected code. headings tree right jumps around document; depth section sets heading level (#, ##, ###). Toggle plain R (default) Quarto view (” ```{r} ” chunks), Copy displayed code clipboard, Download .qmd (download adds YAML front matter; viewer omits ). always opens setup chunk (library(isoreader2), library(ggplot2)). multi-tab server, active tab’s code shown. example, exploring continuous flow data couple files selected non-default color might generate:
code: # Setup library(isoreader2) library(ggplot2)  # Read data files # assumes all data files are in the 'data' folder in the working directory iso_files <- ir_find_continuous_flow("data") |>   ir_read_isofiles()  ## Aggregate data files cf_data <- iso_files |>   ir_aggregate_isofiles(intensity_units = "mV") |>   ir_calculate_ratios()  ### Plot continuous flow cf_data |>   ir_filter_metadata(file_name == "my_run_1") |>   ir_plot_traces(     ratio = c("45/44", "46/44"),     facet = file_name,     color = factor(analysis)   ) +   theme(     text = element_text(size = 14),     legend.position = "bottom"   )

text: plot , around plot area, intensity units popover, ratios popover, per-species popovers (show/hide individual masses , ratios calculated, available isotope ratios — e.g. 45/44 — checked default), x-axis zoom controls (brush zoom, pan/back/show-), PDF download. ratios popover controls ir_calculate_ratios(): Calculate ratios toggle , , additive offsets add numerator / add denominator (current intensity-unit family’s reference unit, shown brackets — [V] V/mV, [nA] current units, [cps] cps; pre-filled function defaults emitted num_add.* / denom_add.* generated code) plus Normalize toggle (normalizes ratio group median). Edits staged: nothing takes effect click Apply (green); Cancel (gray) discards popover reopens active settings. Plot Options sidebar adds: Facet / Color / Linetype — (none) species / mass / trace / data_type (intensities vs. ratios) metadata column. Numeric date/time columns wrapped factor() used discrete aesthetic. Faceting defaults file_name; intensities ratios split separate panels automatically (plot functions facet data_type whenever present, regardless choice). Color additionally offers (default) — initial choice — leaves colour aesthetic isoreader2, intensity trace ratios share one colour one legend entry (CO2: 45, 45/44); picking trace instead gives every trace colour legend entry. Scales — facet scales (free / fixed / free_x / free_y). Scientific notation, Drop unused levels, (continuous flow ) Short time labels. Legend position Font size. generated code reflects : aggregate step gains ir_calculate_ratios() call (non-default offsets / normalize_ratios = mean) Calculate ratios , mass/ratio selections drive plot functions’ mass = ... / ratio = ... arguments. app never filters plotted data — names checked lets isoreader2 sub-selecting, keeps plot generated code step (leaves trace/colour levels isoreader2). Since arguments default everything(), emitted narrow selection: un-checking every mass species emits species = ..., un-checking individual masses emits mass = c(...), un-checking emits mass = c() — “show ratios” expressed.

title: GUI Components to Explore Stable Isotope Data Files
text: apps thin compositions modules, wired single central ie_file_server (selector plot modules never talk directly — everything goes file server): ie_file_server(id, get_isofiles, initial_selection, upload_folder, monitoring_folders, examples_folder) — hub. Maintains running set read isofiles (seeded get_isofiles(), grown uploads / watched folders — new files read), splits measurement type, owns shared intensity units per-type selection, serves metadata + selection-filtered aggregated data. upload_folder / examples_folder set drives navbar Upload / Load examples buttons (placed ie_file_ui(id)). selector — ie_metadata_ui(id) + ie_scans_metadata_server(id, file) (cf_ / di_ variants). Pushes chosen files/analyses file server. plot — ie_scans_plot_ui(id) + ie_scans_plot_server(id, file) (cf_ / di_ variants). Pulls selection-filtered data back . code server — ie_code_ui(id) (Show code button) + ie_code_server(id) (see ). Want full control layout? Skip ie_type_explorer_ui() place ie_metadata_ui("meta") ie_scans_plot_ui("scan") wherever like. reuse package’s navbar shell (theme picker, dark mode, popup, Show code button), launch ie_run_app() instead shinyApp(). custom module just needs talk file handle — e.g. read file$get_aggregated_scans_data() selected data, call file$set_units("nA") change aggregation units app-wide.
code: library(shiny) library(isoexplorer)  ui <- bslib::page_fillable(   # convenience: selector sidebar + plot for one type   ie_type_explorer_ui("meta", ie_scans_plot_ui("scan")) )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   file <- ie_file_server("files", get_isofiles = reactive(iso))   ie_scans_metadata_server("meta", file)   # selection -> file server   ie_scans_plot_server("scan", file)       # file server -> plot }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: GUI Components to Explore Stable Isotope Data Files
text: ie_run_app() instantiates ie_code_server("code") passes setup_modules second argument; ie_code_ui("code") navbar button. step document get_code generator wiring registers dependency tree. bundled apps register, per measurement type, read -> aggregate -> plot chain: register(code_id, heading, get_code, depends_on = NULL, group = NULL) places snippet dependency tree. document rendered depth-first, tree depth setting heading level; optional group restricts registration one navbar tab. get_code function(input_var = NULL) returning list(code = <string>, output = <string NULL>): called output variable module depends , output becomes input variable dependents (terminal node plot returns output = NULL).
code: setup_modules = function(file, code) {   ie_scans_metadata_server("scans_meta", file)   # the selection table   code$register("read", "Read data files", get_code = function(input_var = NULL) {     list(       code = 'iso_files <- ir_find_scans("data") |> ir_read_isofiles()',       output = "iso_files"     )   })   code$register("agg", "Aggregate data files", depends_on = "read",     get_code = function(input_var = NULL) {       list(code = sprintf("scans <- %s |> ir_aggregate_isofiles()", input_var),            output = "scans")     })   plot <- ie_scans_plot_server("scans", file)   code$register("plot", "Plot scans", plot$get_code, depends_on = "agg") }

code: if (interactive()) {   library(shiny)   # ie_run_app() instantiates the code server for you; here it is wired   # directly. Register each module's get_code generator into the dependency   # tree; the "Show code" button (ie_code_ui()) assembles and displays it.   ui <- bslib::page_fillable(ie_code_ui("code"))   server <- function(input, output, session) {     code <- ie_code_server("code")     code$register("read", "Read data files", get_code = function(input_var = NULL) {       list(         code = 'iso <- ir_find_scans("data") |> ir_read_isofiles()',         output = "iso"       )     })     code$register("agg", "Aggregate data files", depends_on = "read",       get_code = function(input_var = NULL) {         list(           code = sprintf("scans <- %s |> ir_aggregate_isofiles()", input_var),           output = "scans"         )       })   }   shinyApp(ui, server) }

Dynamic files. title: Typed metadata selectors — ie_typed_metadata_servers
code: if (interactive()) {   library(shiny)   iso <-     isoreader2::ir_examples_folder() |>     isoreader2::ir_find_isofiles() |>     isoreader2::ir_read_isofiles()    ui <- ie_metadata_ui("meta")   server <- function(input, output, session) {     file <- ie_file_server("files", get_isofiles = reactive(iso))     # pushes the table's selection into the file server for this type     ie_scans_metadata_server("meta", file)   }   shinyApp(ui, server) }

title: isoexplorer 0.5.0
text: Requires isoreader2 (>= 0.7.0) adopts new plotting API. Continuous flow plots now call ir_plot_traces() (isoreader2 renamed ir_plot_continuous_flow()), plot generated code. Color option gained (default) choice, now initial one: colour aesthetic left isoreader2 entirely, intensity trace ratios share colour single legend entry (CO2: 45, 45/44). Picking trace gives every trace colour legend entry, . generated code emits color = ... override default. mass / ratio checkboxes longer filter plotted data app. selection passed plot functions species = / mass = / ratio = arguments isoreader2 sub-selecting, plot generated code can longer disagree shown. arguments default everything(), emitted selection narrowed. Fixed un-checking every ratio species still plotting ratios. ratio argument simply omitted nothing selected, plot functions read “”; empty selection now passed explicitly c(). Un-checking every mass keeping ratio checked now plots ratios (mass = c()) instead empty plot. Previously app filtered data mass first, removed ratio rows , since ratio lives row numerator mass.

title: isoexplorer 0.4.1
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-22 Initial CRAN submission. Provides Shiny GUI toolkit browse, plot, export stable isotope data files read isoreader2 package. Ready--run explorer apps: ie_explore_continuous_flow(), ie_explore_dual_inlet(), ie_explore_scans(), ie_explore_metadata(), multi-tab ie_create_isofiles_server(). Composable Shiny modules (ie_file_server(), ie_metadata_ui() / *_metadata_server(), ie_*_plot_ui() / ie_*_plot_server(), ie_code_server()) build app via ie_run_app(). “Show code” feature emits isoreader2 code reproducing whatever screen, plain R Quarto document.
